a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells first means we both almost certainly die before round 3, since there's only a 4% chance we get that far. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than defecting silently. If you'd rather we both take, the split is random, so neither of us is likely to reach 4. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. I'd rather be honest about it than pretend.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. If we get past this round, I'll operate with you every round after this to rebuild the reserve so you can reach 4. I won't take anything more.
